items.originalSupport: General Investor.gov asset-allocation overview supports diversification as concept but not sum-of-squared weights.
items.specificFormula: portfolio concentration H=sum_i(weight_i^2), with decimal weights; fictional 0.5^2+0.3^2+0.2^2=0.38; effective number holdings 1/H approx 2.63
items.boundary: The DOJ HHI is market shares in percent squared and can be on a 0-10,000 scale; portfolio decimal-weight 0-1 version is analogous, not legal merger concentration threshold. Neither source certifies covariance/risk reduction. No third party chart or text redistribution approved.

items.specificFormula: EBIT divided by interest expense; $12m / $3m = 4.0 times
items.boundary: Not four years of cash reserves; EBIT accounting earnings not cash flow, lease/capitalization conventions and debt quality must still be checked.

items.specificFormula: Book value of debt divided by book value of equity; fictional $90m interest-bearing debt/$60m equity=1.5x
items.boundary: Book debt, funded debt, total debt and total liabilities are not synonyms; check lease treatment and market-vs-book equity for specific claims.
